ABOUT ZENBU

A place for what happens next.

Zenbu is being built for South Africans with a view on the future. Our first focus is Private Pools: prediction competitions with the people you know.

The wider vision brings together prediction contracts, community pools, a wallet, a marketplace and rewards. Each product will launch progressively, subject to its requirements and availability.
